title: Bid Project Manager
description:
**Who is Turner \& Townsend?** 




 All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data center they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.
 



  





**Job description** 




 The Bid Manager will be responsible for driving best practice approaches and high\-quality bids in our 400\-person strong Turner \& Townsend Hyderabad team. Acting at both an advisory and hands\-on level, the successful candidate will be an experienced bid professional with strong stakeholder management skills and a track record for delivering complex proposals in a collaborative environment. They will be confident constructively challenging stakeholders and have an outcome focused, can\-do mindset.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Lead a best practice approach and the execution of proposals, tenders and bid responses. This includes:
* Reviewing procurement documentation, leading bid go/no go discussions, and formulating a clear plan for delivering a compelling offer.
* Acting as bid manager by mobilizing internal stakeholders, setting timelines and overseeing execution against the plan.
* Complying with the Turner \& Townsend “bid to win” process and governance requirements
* Facilitating discussions focused on differentiators, win themes and content to ensure high quality answers are developed.
* Working with Directors and other functional teams to deliver tender responses through collation of information, writing tender responses directly, or supporting others to produce quality responses.
* Working with external organizations and partners to develop and deliver bids and proposals.
* Delivering a professional bid that complies with brand guidelines and clearly and succinctly communicates key messages.
* Providing constructive feedback or escalating concerns to senior leadership and partner organizations throughout the bid and interview process
* Ensuring that all deadlines are met and that bids are submitted on time, and in the correct manner.
* Supporting positioning activities and Bid Leadership that support high conversion and business development activity. Examples include undertaking competitor research, market analysis or interrogating client feedback.
* Supporting the preparation of other deliverables related to conversion and work winning, such as interview presentation coaching and procurement team engagement.
* Reporting on pipeline and bid conversion at office and sector levels, including providing analysis and commentary on trends.
* Contribute to content libraries and best practice approaches by overseeing maintenance of content and bid libraries.
* Working alongside a team of existing bid professionals
* Support Business Development with other activities, as required



**Qualifications** 



* Relevant degree in Business, Marketing, English or engineering.
* Association of Proposal Management Professional (APMP) accreditation desired, or willing to be completed
* Minimum 7 years' experience of bid management and writing successful bid submissions
* Line management experience desirable
* Strong skills in Microsoft office suite, including PowerPoint and Word
* Proof reading skills with a keen eye for accuracy and detail, including ensuring responses adhere to word/page limits
* Organizational skills, with the ability to priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality
* Communicate confidently and effectively, verbally and in writing and ability to foster credible collaborative relationships
* Team player who is willing to adapt to changing priorities of the business
* Contribute openly to the team with innovations and ideas to ensure the success and development of the company

title: Mars Statutory Transformation Europe Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 The
 **Mars Statutory Transformation Europe Lead** 
 is responsible for leading statutory financial reporting, local regulatory compliance, and statutory reporting requirements across European countries as part of a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role serves as the primary Finance and Controllership SME for European statutory reporting requirements, ensuring local GAAP, IFRS, financial statement, disclosure, and regulatory reporting obligations are incorporated into the SAP S/4HANA global template. The individual partners with Corporate Finance, Regional Controllers, Tax, IT, Shared Services, and System Integrators to design, test, and deploy compliant statutory reporting processes and technologies (e.g. SAP DRC reporting or other statutory reporting solutions).
   

  

**What are we Looking For?**
* 8\+ years of experience in statutory financial reporting, controllership, external reporting, or financial accounting.
* Strong knowledge of European statutory reporting obligations and local GAAP requirements.
* Deep understanding of IFRS reporting and European regulatory reporting requirements.
* Experience supporting SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Finance transformations.
* Experience with statutory reporting technologies such as SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, Workiva, CCH Tagetik, BlackLine, or similar solutions.
* Strong understanding of Record\-to\-Report (R2R), financial close, consolidation, and external reporting processes.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, financial statement versions, and reporting architecture.
* Experience with Statutory Fixed Asset requirements in SAP
* Proven experience defining statutory reporting requirements and leading testing and deployment activities.
* Experience supporting multi\-country European deployments within a global template model.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across Finance, Controllership, Tax, IT, Shared Services, and external auditors.
* Experience managing compliance risks, governance processes, and complex transformation programs.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
* CPA, ACA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent accounting qualification preferred.


**What are the Key Responsibilities?**
* Lead the Europe statutory reporting workstream for SAP S/4HANA design, build, testing, and deployment.
* Serve as the primary SME for statutory financial reporting requirements across European jurisdictions.
* Define and validate local GAAP, IFRS, statutory financial statement, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Ensure European statutory requirements are incorporated into the global S/4HANA template while balancing standardization and localization.
* Partner with Controllership, Record\-to\-Report (R2R), Tax, Consolidation, and Finance teams to align reporting requirements.
* Define statutory reporting requirements related to legal entities, ledgers, charts of accounts, account mappings, and financial statement hierarchies.
* Lead requirements and design reviews for SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, and other statutory compliance reporting technologies.
* Support finance design decisions involving parallel accounting, local GAAP adjustments, statutory journals, and reporting structures.
* Establish statutory reporting governance, controls, and compliance monitoring procedures.
* Assess the impact of new accounting and regulatory requirements on SAP processes and reporting solutions.
* Lead statutory reporting testing, defect management, business validation, and sign\-off activities.
* Support deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with country finance teams to ensure local compliance requirements are fully addressed.
* Preferred SAP S/4HANA Transformation Experience:
+ Led statutory reporting workstreams for European SAP S/4HANA deployments.
+ Defined reporting requirements across key European jurisdictions including EU and non\-EU markets.
+ Designed statutory reporting solutions leveraging SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal and parallel ledger capabilities.
+ Implemented SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, or similar regulatory reporting solutions.
+ Defined requirements for local statutory financial statements, disclosures, and regulatory filings.
+ Led statutory UAT, defect management, cutover, deployment readiness, and hypercare activities.
+ Supported global template governance while ensuring country\-specific statutory compliance.
+ Collaborated with Finance GPOs, Regional Controllers, Tax, and System Integrators throughout the program lifecycle.
+ Supported audit readiness and external audit requirements during deployment and post\-go\-live operations.


**Key Deliverables**
* Approved European statutory reporting requirements and design decisions.
* Country statutory reporting requirement inventories and localization assessments.
* Local GAAP and IFRS reporting requirements documented and incorporated into solution design.
* SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, or equivalent compliance solution requirements and deployment sign\-off.
* Financial statement hierarchy, disclosure, and account mapping requirements.
* Statutory reporting process flows, operating procedures, and governance documentation.
* Statutory controls framework and compliance monitoring processes.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, scripts, execution results, and defect resolution tracking.
* Country\-specific statutory reporting readiness assessments.
* Executive reporting on statutory reporting readiness, compliance risks, and key decisions.
* Go\-live readiness and post\-production support plans.
* Knowledge transfer materials and operational support documentation.


**What can you expect from Mars?**
 Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in\-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

title: Events Platform Manager
description:
**Job Title: Events Platform Manager**
* Location: Hyderabad


**About Sanofi**
 We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R\&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.
   

  

 Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R\&D and consequent new launches in our history. The Go\-to\-Market Capabilities Team was organized to consolidate business operations efforts globally across all business units with an eye to create efficiencies that fund our pipeline and prepare us to drive multiple new product launches as we strive to materialize the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
   

  

**About The Job**
 The Events Platform \- Manager role is a part of the Go\-to\-Market Capabilities (GTMC), Customer Facing Capabilities (CFC), CRM \& Enablers team. The GTMC organization drives best\-in\-class capabilities and brings value and excellence in commercial operations. The GTMC organization is a key part of the modernization of Sanofi and allows all business operations efforts to be focused on Sanofi "Take the Lead" priorities across products, markets, and pipelines. It accomplishes these goals through realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision\-making process.
   

  

 This role serves as the technical authority for Events and Congresses platform operations within OneCRM US, supporting the strategic vision for event platform capabilities, data governance, and system evolution. This leader ensures system enhancements operate as intended and advises on scalable event platform solutions that support multi\-brand, multi\-market launch requirements, ensuring enterprise\-wide compliance, data integrity, and continuous platform transformation across all Promotional and Non\-Promotional event types (Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings etc.).
   

  

 This position will work closely with CRM \& Enablers Team members in the US, US\-based stakeholders, Hyderabad HUB resources, contracted system enhancement resources, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Field Engagement Management, Business Operations, Compliance, other GTMC pillars, Veeva, and Sanofi Digital to support the end\-to\-end design, governance, and evolution of the Events and Congresses platform across the OneCRM US ecosystem. This leader serves as a strategic partner across the enterprise, supporting platform direction, data governance standards, User Acceptance testing and operational frameworks that underpin compliant, high\-performing event execution at scale.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Support the strategic vision and roadmap for Events Management platform capabilities across OneCRM US, ensuring alignment with enterprise Events \& Congress standards and business priorities
* Serve as the technical lead for Veeva Events and Congresses enhancement user acceptance testing and issue investigation/resolution, overseeing service ticket process and driving associated improvements to the process
* Identify and recommend scalable event platform solutions supporting multi\-brand Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings across multiple markets and business units
* Drive enterprise\-wide data discrepancy investigation and correction for Compliance and Transparency events data, establishing data quality standards and reconciliation frameworks for transparency, compliance, and data integrity across all event types and downstream systems
* Ensure accurate end\-to\-end event platform frameworks and processes — including topic management, speaker profiles, budgets, and nomination and content submission tools — that scale with organizational growth and platform evolution
* Mentor the events platform operations team, providing technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and career development support that elevates individual and team capability
* Influence technical decisions across requirements gathering, system enhancements, and UAT for major platform initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, and fit for enterprise purposes
* Contribute toshape of the long\-term roadmap for Events and Congresses platform evolution and integration with downstream systems, including iCare, transparency, FMV, GRF, and contracting
* Lead change management efforts for Service Ticket (ESM) enhancements and evolution, driving adoption and alignment across field teams, Field Engagement Management, and business stakeholders including the creation of knowledge based articles.
* Drive capability building across the broader CRM community through structured knowledge sharing, best practice development, and train\-the\-trainer programs
* Partner with Field Engagement Management, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Business Operations to influence event platform strategy and ensure the platform meets evolving business requirements
* Oversight of service/incident ticket process for events , establishing performance measurement frameworks and continuous improvement approaches that drive platform excellence
* Investigate and remediate escalated inquiries, applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues and prevent recurrence through systemic process improvements
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration across partner GTMC US teams, ensuring event platform strategies are integrated with broader CRM and Global Events and Congress initiatives and enterprise data standards
* Partner with internal and external vendor technical teams to ensure platform readiness


**About Our Team**
 The CRM \& Enablers Team is a part of the GTMC organization in the US. The CRM \& Enablers Team strives to support our business customer facing teams by delivering innovative CRM capabilities that are timely, reliable, accurate, and constantly improving. We focus on our customers — both brand teams and customer facing teams — to adapt our CRM platform and operational systems to meet their needs. Our efforts to streamline and maintain OneCRM US bring value and impact to the organization by reducing the manual workload on our customer facing teams, by providing accurate activity data back to reporting systems, and acting as the nexus of data flow to and from Sanofi data systems. This team operates as a strategic partner to the business, driving platform excellence and enabling compliant, high\-impact field engagement at enterprise scale.
   

  

**About The Candidate**
 This candidate has a demonstrated track record of leading technical teams, influencing enterprise platform strategy, and designing scalable event platform solutions across multiple business units and product launches. They bring deep expertise in Veeva Events and Congresses, data governance, and compliance requirements — including PhRMA guidelines and transparency reporting — combined with the ability to translate complex technical platform requirements into enterprise\-wide operational frameworks. This leader has experience architecting event management solutions, driving process transformation, and building organizational capability at scale. They are skilled at influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Field Engagement Management, navigating complex matrix environments, and shaping platform strategy across concurrent launch programs. Strong English communication skills and availability to engage with US stakeholders with significant operational hour overlap are essential.
   

  

 Ideal Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four\-year college or university (Project Management Masters or MBA preferred)
* 7\+ years of progressive events platform and CRM operations experience with demonstrated leadership
* 7\+ years of experience in Biotechnology or Pharmaceuticals
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving strategic platform initiatives across enterprise\-scale programs
* Experience in solution architecture for event management platforms and CRM systems
* Advanced expertise in data governance, compliance requirements (PhRMA guidelines), and data integrity across events and transparency reporting
* Strong knowledge and experience with Veeva Events and Congresses, Agile processes, and event management systems
* Deep understanding of the events ecosystem including transparency, FMV, GRF, contracting, and field engagement integration
* A keen eye for improvement opportunities and the demonstrated ability to deliver on these opportunities
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain not only the requirements and the "ask", but also the "why" with credibility
* Motivated, energetic, and a respected contributor who engages and elevates others
* Ability to change behaviors to evolve to the company's strategies and initiatives
* Experience working and thriving in a matrix environment
* Strong English communication skills with the ability to engage and align diverse stakeholders across geographies and functions

title: Operations Fulfilment Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 AdOnMo is one of India's largest and fastest\-growing Out\-of\-Home (OOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors like Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a vast and expanding network of 33,000\+ digital screens (outside lifts) and 20,000\+ static frame posters (inside lifts) across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our ad formats are installed in high\-visibility public locations, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Cult.fit gyms
* Goa beaches
* Shopping malls
* Bike parking areas with branded standees and digital hoardings



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping them build real\-world visibility through innovative and targeted outdoor advertising campaigns.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Operations Fulfilment Manager to join the Acumen team and take ownership of the fulfilment journey end\-to\-end.
 



 The role will involve coordinating closely with production, warehouse, installation, Operations and Customer Success teams to ensure orders move as planned, timelines are met, and client escalations are resolved effectively.
 



 The ideal candidate should be organised, dependable, hands\-on, and comfortable working across multiple teams, with strong ownership of execution and follow\-through.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience: 3\+ years



  





  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* *1\. Own Fulfilment End\-to\-End*
* Track every order from production and dispatch through delivery, installation and go\-live.
* Maintain complete visibility on the status of every open order.
* Ensure orders progress through each stage as planned and are successfully closed.



  




* *2\. Drive Coordination and Timelines*
* Work closely with Production, Warehouse, Installation, Operations and Customer Success teams.
* Identify potential delays and bottlenecks early.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure orders move as planned and timelines are met.



  




* *3\. Own Client Escalations*
* Take complete ownership of client escalations related to fulfilment.
* Communicate clearly and calmly with stakeholders.
* Drive issues through to closure and ensure that escalations do not remain unresolved.



  




* *4\. Keep the Team and Process on Track*
* Support the existing Operations team in managing day\-to\-day fulfilment activities.
* Maintain a simple, accurate and up\-to\-date order tracker.
* Follow up on pending actions and ensure clear accountability for every next step.
* Maintain visibility on pending orders and ensure timely follow\-ups.



  




* *5\. Identify and Improve Recurring Issues*
* Identify patterns and recurring challenges in the fulfilment process.
* Proactively highlight issues to leadership.
* Suggest practical process improvements to reduce recurring fulfilment challenges and improve operational efficiency.



  





  





  





**Required Skills** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Operations, Fulfilment, Client Delivery, Service Delivery or a similar role.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end fulfilment or delivery processes.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to work across multiple teams.
* Experience handling client/stakeholder escalations and driving them to closure.
* Strong follow\-up and execution skills.
* Comfortable maintaining trackers, monitoring pending actions and managing multiple orders simultaneously.
* Ability to identify operational challenges and suggest practical solutions.
* Highly organised, dependable and hands\-on approach to work.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in a similar Operations, Fulfilment, Service Delivery, Client Delivery, Logistics, Installation or Project Execution role would be preferred.



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 AdOnMo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Manager, SCM-Business Excellence
description:
Build a career with confidence
   

  

 Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world\-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.
   

  

 Title: Manager, SCM\-Business Excellence
   

  

**About The Role**
 Leads team of intermediate to experienced Procurement professionals, setting objectives and guiding others on RFPs, negotiation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution. Reviews prices, manufacturing processes, and contracts and makes recommendations for changes to ensure a successful procurement process.
   

  

 The Manager, SCM – Business Excellence: Data \& Process Transformation will lead the supply chain transformation agenda across Productivity \& Cost Savings, Price Change Governance, Payment Terms, and Master Data (Vendor Master \& Supplier Onboarding). This role demands deep experience in supply chain operations, strong people leadership, and the ability to execute high\-impact programs that drive measurable business value.
   

  

 The Manager will own strategy, design, and execution of supply chain data and process transformation initiatives spanning procurement, sourcing, and category management, including price change governance, payment\-term centralization, vendor master management, and supplier onboarding, with direct accountability for portfolio delivery across global sites and stakeholders. The role includes managing a team of specialists/analysts, leading cross\-functional programs, and partnering with global supply chain, finance, and operations leaders to deliver scalable, digitally enabled business solutions.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Manages execution of processes, standards, and operational plans in support of Procurement strategy, including RFPs, negotation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution.
* Directs programs for effective vendor selection and management with a view to minimize purchasing costs without compromising quality or reliability of supply.
* Reviews changes in price trends and manufacturing processes and makes recommendations to ensure successful procurement process.
* Manages resolution of client issues or problems.
* Monitors and coordinates suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries to ensure resolution of problems such as shortages and missed or late deliveries.
* Authorizes purchase orders, negotiates prices and approves payments to support the procurement process in large territories.
* Reviews and assesses request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages.
* Analyzes and monitors contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and to help determine need for changes.


**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Leadership in Process Transformation
* Define and own the transformation roadmap across the core pillars: Productivity \& Cost Savings (reporting, value\-capture tracking \& automation), Price Change / Price Updating Governance, Master Data governance \& standardization (vendor master, item, and contract data), Supplier Onboarding centralization, and Payment Terms \& Working Capital optimization (DPO, 1x centralization).
* Lead a team of specialists/analysts and drive portfolio execution against business targets for these pillars: \-
* Productivity \& Cost Savings: Centralize productivity and cost\-savings reporting across factory, indirect, and logistics sites; run the stage\-gate / value\-capture process end to end, and identify and recover clawbacks and missed opportunities to convert pipeline into realized savings.
* Master Data \& Vendor Master: Standardize and govern supplier, vendor, item, and contract master data; own data quality, validation rules, and de\-duplication to maintain a clean, reliable vendor master consistent across systems and regions.
* Payment Terms \& Working Capital: Expand payment\-term (DPO) initiatives, centralize 1x governance, and target WAPT improvements with measurable working\-capital impact.
* Supplier Onboarding: Centralize and simplify the supplier onboarding process; standardize intake, documentation, and data setup with clear SLAs and controls to enable faster, compliant onboarding across regions.
* Price Change / Price Updation Governance: Own the end\-to\-end price change process and controls; ensure timely, accurate price updation in the system with the right approvals, audit trail, and exception management, working closely with category, materials, and finance teams.
* Analyze end\-to\-end supply chain processes to identify structural improvement opportunities; drive strategic changes to improve cost, speed, compliance, and operational resilience.
* Lead, coach, and develop specialists/analysts; allocate resources, prioritize work, and review deliverables to ensure high\-quality outcomes and meet business milestones.
* Reporting, Governance, and Oversight
* Lead the design and implementation of Power BI/Excel dashboards for executive\-level analytics, insights, and business metrics across procurement and inbound supply chain.
* Own the governance model for critical procurement metrics, including cadence, definitions, and alignment with finance and category teams.
* Drive transformation and centralization of reporting with a strong focus on automation, data integrity, and auditability.
* Own procurement master data quality KPIs and governance processes, ensuring consistency across systems (e.g., SAP/Oracle) and regions.
* Advanced Stakeholder \& Team Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for global and regional procurement, category management, and sourcing leaders on master data and reporting topics.
* Align transformation projects with business priorities; provide regular updates to senior leadership on progress, risks, and impact.
* Promote effective collaboration and communication across global teams; facilitate workshops and steering meetings to harmonize processes and standards.
* Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes, data definitions, and tools, balancing global governance with local business needs.
* Technical Competencies \& Advanced Analytics
* Oversee the use of Excel, ERP, Power BI, and other tools for scalable enterprise reporting and analytics.
* Lead advanced analytical initiatives driving business value across the key projects owned.
* Sponsor and guide automation and system\-integration efforts to reduce manual work and improve data reliability.
* Champion digital and analytics innovation in supply chain reporting and master data (e.g., standardization, data quality rules, exception management, and workflow).


**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
* 12\+ years’ experience in supply chain or manufacturing, with significant exposure to data/process transformation, procurement, sourcing, and category management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain management, master data governance, procurement analytics, and operational finance with hands\-on experience in data quality initiatives and reporting automation.
* Proven experience managing teams (5\+) and leading complex programs or transformation initiatives in a global environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; advanced experience with Power BI, ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), and emerging digital tools strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of driving transformation, simplifying complex data landscapes, and delivering measurable business impact.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change.
* High learning agility, accountability, and strong collaboration skills across cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams.


 Additional Comments
   

  

* Full time role

title: Sr Manager, Procurement Platform Excellence
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all* 
 .**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

 The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best\-in\-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills\-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
   

  

 As Senior Manager, Platform Excellence within Global Procurement’s Center of Excellence Digital Transformation \& AI organization, you drive the Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) platform strategy and roadmap and lead end\-to\-end management of the S2P platform landscape. This is a collaborative role: you shape one coherent S2P platform direction together with your peer Senior Managers for S/4HANA Transformation, AI Transformation, Data \& Process Automation, and Data Excellence \& Governance. Your portfolio spans sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure\-to\-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team, and you lead a team based in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 This is not a SAP or ERP configuration role. The SAP S/4HANA and Ariba transformation is driven by a separate team; you partner closely with them so the S2P platform landscape integrates cleanly with the ERP core and enterprise systems, and every platform decision reinforces one coherent, standardized S2P experience. Similarly, new AI transformation products that are still at an early, incubation stage sit with the AI Transformation team — your accountability is the established S2P platform portfolio and how it is run, integrated, and adopted.
   

  

 You set direction and priorities and own value realization measured in real business terms — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality. You bring strong product and user\-centered discipline to how the portfolio is run: grounding decisions in user personas, journeys, and end\-to\-end processes, and owning supplier\-supported and third\-party products end\-to\-end, including escalation, supplier performance (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end\-of\-life transitions.
   

  

 This is a people\-leadership role. A core part of your mandate is to move platform operations from reactive, ticket\-driven support to a proactive, agent\-embedded model, and to embed product and user\-centered discipline across the portfolio. You develop a team of platform and product professionals and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data \& Process Automation, Data Excellence \& Governance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Compliance. GP\-centric platform products are owned here end\-to\-end; enterprise\-wide systems and IT infrastructure remain with IT — the role does not perform software development or manage infrastructure.
   

  

**▍** 
**Key Responsibilities**
 A core expectation is to run Global Procurement’s Source\-to\-Pay platforms as products — end\-to\-end, value\-driven, well\-integrated, and adopted — while moving platform operations toward a proactive, agent\-embedded model.
   

  

**Platform Strategy \& Value Optimization**
* Own the end\-to\-end S2P platform portfolio strategy and roadmap — including the analytics and reporting platforms — framing business problems into clear product strategies that maximize outcomes over outputs.
* Prioritize opportunities and make build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner trade\-offs, sequencing platform investment against S2P Reimagined and ERP transformation milestones.
* Track value through real business indicators — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality — and engage stakeholders on investment decisions and supplier and technology trends.


**End\-to\-End Platform Leadership \& Lifecycle**
* Lead and be accountable for the S2P platform portfolio across its full lifecycle — sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure\-to\-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and analytics platforms — setting clear direction and adapting priorities as needs evolve.
* Own supplier\-supported and third\-party products for GP\-centric solutions, including escalation, supplier performance management (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end\-of\-life transitions.
* Apply product\-management fundamentals — budgeting, cost\-versus\-value trade\-offs, and lifecycle planning — to keep platforms fit\-for\-purpose as scale and complexity grow, while keeping GP\-centric solutions PM\-owned and enterprise\-wide systems with IT.


**Platform Operations, Integration \& Health**
* Own platform stability, configuration, release, environment and test, and incident and problem management across the S2P landscape.
* Ensure the S2P platforms integrate cleanly with the SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core and enterprise systems, so data, controls, and processes flow reliably end\-to\-end.
* Establish platform health KPIs, service levels, and monitoring, and shift from reactive support to proactive, increasingly self\-healing platforms — with agents handling detection, triage, routing, and routine configuration and testing.


**Analytics Platforms, Adoption \& Product Performance**
* Product\-manage the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team — ensuring the tooling is reliable, well\-integrated, and fit\-for\-purpose, while analytics outputs and insights remain owned by the data analytics team.
* Instrument platforms to measure usage, adoption, and value, and use those signals to refine roadmaps and features.
* Define what “good adoption” means beyond usage — decision confidence, reduced rework, and behavior change.


**User\-Centered Solution Design**
* Ground solutions in user personas, journeys, and end\-to\-end process understanding, balancing usability, feasibility, business value, and enterprise constraints.
* Challenge low\-value features and over\-customization; advocate scalable, standard\-driven design and consistent interaction patterns across S2P tools and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Anticipate adoption risks and continuously improve solutions based on user behavior and usage signals.


**Stakeholder Engagement, Enablement \& Change**
* Engage stakeholders, build trust, and bring people along through change; translate needs into clear action plans and resolve issues through influence and partnership.
* Own the platform enablement and support model — training, documentation, self\-service, and a responsive support experience across regions.
* Embed change management into the product journey and drive adoption through clear, simple, actionable communication.


**Innovation \& Agent\-Embedded Ways of Working**
* Reimagine platform operations and enablement with agents embedded — platform support copilot, configuration and testing agents, integration\-monitoring agents, and enablement copilot.
* Sponsor rapid experiments, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source\-to\-Pay.


**Team Leadership \& Enterprise Partnership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a Hyderabad\-based team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach the team for a product\-led, agent\-embedded operating model.
* Partner across DTAI pillars, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, and functional Global Procurement teams, and represent the platform agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for platform stability, integration, and adoption risks, translating complex dynamics into clear decisions and tradeoffs for senior stakeholders.


**▍** 
**Leadership Expectations**
 This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
   

  

**People**
 Care for each other — build an inclusive, high\-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession within the team.
   

  

**Innovation**
 Shape the future — run platforms as products and champion agent\-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
   

  

**Tenacity**
 Nothing shakes our resolve — own platform stability, integration, and adoption outcomes end\-to\-end through complex, cross\-system challenges.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Aligned to win — break silos across DTAI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
   

  

**Customer Focus**
 Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end\-users as customers; design for their journeys and deliver adopted, high\-value platforms.
   

  

**Speed**
 Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well\-reasoned decisions and move prioritized platform work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
   

  

**▍** 
**Leadership Competencies**
* Product \& value judgment: Frame problems into value\-driven strategy, prioritize outcomes over outputs, and make build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner calls with clarity.
* User\-centered \& adoption mindset: Design for real user journeys and adoption, not just delivery, and define value beyond usage.
* Talent \& coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi\-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
* Cross\-cultural leadership: Work effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, partnering with globally distributed stakeholders and peers.
* Influence \& partnership: Lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Executive communication: Translate complex platform, integration, and product topics into crisp, decision\-ready narratives for senior leaders.
* Change leadership: Drive adoption of new platforms and agent\-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
* Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable stability, adoption, and value.


**▍ Minimum Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience — depth: 13\+ years in enterprise platform, digital product, or Source\-to\-Pay application management, including 5\+ years leading platform or digital product delivery and operations and 3\+ years leading teams.
* Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi\-region enterprise (5,000\+ employees), including environments running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
* Experience — domain: Deep, hands\-on ownership of a Source\-to\-Pay platform landscape (several of sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure\-to\-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and procurement analytics platforms), with close working knowledge of how these integrate with an SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core.
* Product management: Proven end\-to\-end product ownership — vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization — with a track record of driving outcomes over outputs.
* Supplier / third\-party product management: Managing supplier\-supported products, including escalation, SLAs, performance reviews, licensing, renewals, and end\-of\-life transitions.
* Analytics \& adoption: Working knowledge of analytics and business intelligence (Power BI or Tableau) and of instrumenting products to measure adoption and value.
* Integration: Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with an ERP core — APIs, middleware, connectors, and cross\-system data and controls.
* AI / agentic ways of working: Experience defining requirements for, or embedding, AI agents into platform operations, support, configuration, testing, or enablement.
* Cross\-functional leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise\-scale, multi\-region initiatives.
* Ways of working: Able to collaborate across U.S. and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with U.S.\-based stakeholders and partners.


**▍ Preferred Requirements**
* Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands\-on experience with Source\-to\-Pay or procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Icertis, or Ironclad) and procurement analytics platforms.
* Experience reimagining platform operations and enablement with AI or agents embedded.
* Service management (ITIL) and Agile or DevOps ways of working for enterprise applications.
* Depth in Source\-to\-Pay and Procure\-to\-Pay processes and the broader procurement platform landscape.

description:

 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll be doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's global video conferencing estate and collaboration spaces, driving standardization and lifecycle governance across 400\+ video conferencing units and our global refresh roadmap. Architect and govern the refresh program, aligned to the $1\.2M allocated budget. The program executes prioritization based on site strategy (Grow/Maintain/Retire), technology lifecycle status (including TLMP\-driven replacements), and room usage/telemetry. This prioritization focuses investment on high\-value rooms. This role will own room standards, VC platforms/devices, monitoring/telemetry, lifecycle/refresh execution architecture, and site readiness planning w/ local facilities teams. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global VC/Rooms architecture \& standards: Define room typologies, standard bills of material, supported device classes (including standardization toward MTR patterns), configuration baselines, and supportability guardrails.
* FY27 lifecycle refresh governance (budget\-aligned): Architect the FY27 refresh plan using lifecycle/usage/site strategy and manage quarterly prioritization and rebalancing aligned to the $1\.2M allocation and quarterly budget phasing.
* EoL/risk management for decommissioned devices: Drive remediation for restricted\-state/EoL devices (e.g., impacted Cisco models listed as decommissioned/restricted) and ensure sequencing reduces user impact and operational risk.
* "Replace on failure" and non\-planned remediation architecture: Define technical standards and governance for emergency replacements and quality enhancements due to unexpected site changes, room remodels, device/peripheral failures, or accessory requirements.
* Monitoring \& proactive operations enablement: Expand monitoring approaches and define quality/performance telemetry standards to proactively address support gaps and reduce escalations.
* Network and SD‑WAN dependency management (room readiness): Architect readiness and validation patterns for network changes that impact VC rooms (e.g., SD‑WAN upgrades requiring on‑site testing of all units; dynamic implementation dates; site testing quantities and readiness discipline).
* Facilities/site leader engagement: Partner with Facilities leads to confirm competing plans, validate site strategy, and ensure refresh deployments align to workplace changes and constraints.
* Vendor technical leadership \& platform transition planning: Lead technical evaluation across VC ecosystems (including Webex upgrades/major platform changes and onboarding automation where applicable) and ensure alignment to global standards and support models.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise video conferencing / AV / collaboration spaces architecture, including global standardization and refresh programs.
* Proven track record managing lifecycle transitions and EoL/EoS remediation across a large VC estate, using telemetry/usage insights to prioritize investments.
* Strong cross\-functional delivery leadership—comfortable operating at the intersection of Workplace/Facilities, Network, and UC Engineering/Operations to deliver room readiness and consistent user experience.
* Strong program governance and operational discipline

title: Consulting Practice Leader
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment**
* Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
* Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
* Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.


**Architecture Design and Deployment**
* Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood.

Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.

Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.

Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.

title: Creative Lead
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**What does a Create Lead at WPP Production do?**
 We are seeking a highly creative and driven Creative Team Lead to inspire and manage a team of talented designers, copywriters, and other creatives. You will be responsible for overseeing the creative development and execution of high\-impact campaigns for our prestigious clients. This role demands a strong understanding of brand strategy, visual communication, and the ability to translate marketing objectives into compelling creative solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

* Design Direction: Lead the creative process from concept to completion, ensuring all work aligns with client briefs, brand guidelines, and overall strategic objectives and work closely with Art Director / Brand\-guardian team.
* Team Management: Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of creatives, fostering a collaborative and inspiring work environment. Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify opportunities for professional development.
* Client Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, presenting creative concepts, addressing feedback, and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Project Management: Oversee project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
* Innovation \& Inspiration: Stay up\-to\-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices. Encourage experimentation and innovation within the team.
* Quality Control: Review and approve all creative deliverables, ensuring the highest standards of quality and consistency.
* Brand Stewardship: Develop a deep understanding of client brands and ensure all creative work accurately reflects their values and messaging.


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Bachelor's degree in Design, Advertising, Marketing, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in a creative leadership role, preferably within an agency setting.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns for world\-class brands. Strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of creative work.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma and GEN AI.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Architect Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 People Management
   

  

 Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
   

  

 Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
   

  

 Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
   

  

 Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
   

  

 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
   

  

 Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
   

  

 Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
   

  

 Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end\-to\-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

title: Associate Manager Medical Supply Operations
description:
**Role :** 
 Associate Manager \- Medical Supply Operations
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 The Associate Manager – Medical Supply Operations is accountable for developing and maintaining sustainable operational processes and relationships with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) in outsourced medical supply chain activities. Scope includes Externally Sponsored Research (ESR) studies requiring commercial product supply, Managed Access Programs (MAP) product supply for structured programs and single patient requests (when outsourced), Post Trial Access (PTA) product supply management (when outsourced), Humanitarian programs, and associated distribution activities.
   

  

**Main Activities Will Include (but Not Limited To)**
* Set up and lead outsourced supply management, from supply forecast to product delivery to sponsor locations/investigational sites, including packaging and labelling if applicable, with Medical Operations, Manufacturing \& Supply (M\&S)/Distribution functional teams, Clinical Supply Chain Operations, and CMC (depending on related medical activities)
* Provide oversight of outsourced supply management for medical operations (e.g., tracking of CMO Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), periodic review of invoices)
* Ensure outsourced supply activities are appropriately built into Sanofi and CMO tools to maintain full tracking/chain of custody, allowing proper and efficient supply/resupply of products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs)
* Manage Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) including relationship oversight, performance monitoring, and compliance verification to ensure quality standards and delivery commitments are met
* Proactively identify and manage risks associated with product supply; support internal monthly and quarterly business reviews of programs with key stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and pharmaceutical quality standards throughout the supply chain, including proper storage conditions, temperature control, and chain of custody documentation
* Support audit readiness activities, including internal and external audits related to supply operations, and contribute to timely closure of audit findings
* Support Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management for supply\-related deviations and non\-conformances; contribute to root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions


**People**
* Report primarily to the Team Lead – Supply Operations, Sanofi Business Operations
* Serve as a key contact for Contract Manufacturing Organizations and coordinate with all internal stakeholders
* Represent the team in supply/manufacturing discussions and communicate appropriately with all internal groups regarding adequate supply and issue resolution
* Serve as primary contact for ad hoc requests from various Business Unit functions and Local/Regional teams for supply forecast data and shipment information
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Medical Operations, Humanitarian, and PTA teams
* Collaborate effectively with Quality, Clinical Supply Chain Operations (CSCO), country supply chains, and other cross\-functional partners
* Actively contribute to a culture of continuous learning by sharing knowledge and best practices within the team


**Performance**
* Ensure deliverables meet required timelines, quality targets, and compliance requirements; Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
* Manage risk and implement back\-up plans when needed; investigate root causes when issues arise and recommend remediation plans
* Evaluate the service level provided by CMOs; report data on CMO KPIs and metrics, update and distribute dashboards
* Be solution\-oriented, leveraging and adapting existing methods and procedures to resolve moderately complex problems
* Identify and capitalize on opportunities to develop tools, technology, and processes to improve quality and productivity
* Deliver projects as per agreed timelines with agility and high quality
* Track and report on individual delivery milestones and operational KPIs to the Team Lead on a regular cadence


**Process**
* Perform supply planning and order management activities including cross\-checking orders against forecast
* Support the team with CMO Request for Proposal (RFP) and Technical Conditions completion
* Own program/study demand forecast in Kinaxis; includes data entry, alignment with open orders and financial plan, and communication with local/regional teams to understand demand drivers, identify gaps, and ensure resolution
* Identify, communicate, and escalate root causes of any variations to the program/study forecast
* Support Global Medical Operations with financial planning activities including development of financial plan (3x per year), quarterly landing exercise, and detailed year\-end shipment tracking
* Perform monthly shipment reconciliation; includes detailed review of shipments, identification, and resolution of discrepancies
* Work closely with the Global Supply Planning team to ensure supply is secured for all product requests
* Ensure contractual requirements are met including minimum shelf life, packaging updates, etc.
* Partner with Global Medical Operations to manage order backlogs; includes liaising with customer service, problem solving, and interaction with local markets
* Track inventory and replenishment planning at the CMOs
* Ensure proper documentation and record\-keeping in compliance with pharmaceutical regulations and internal quality management systems
* Drive best practices for effective operations and contribute toward scaling existing competencies within the team


**Stakeholders**
* Medical Product Supply Lead, GBU Medical Programs Governance Leads, Operations Leads, MAP Managers, ESR Managers, Humanitarian Program and PTA Operations Leads
* Demand and Supply Leads, Quality Business Partners
* CSCO, CMC, Quality, Finance, CMO Project Managers and Procurement team
* Other functions as per supply activity needs
* Regulatory Affairs, Distribution Partners, Logistics Providers, and Country Medical Teams


**About You**
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in clinical/medical supply operations such as demand \& supply forecasting and packaging \& labelling order management; demonstrated experience in managing vendor relationships and outsourced operations
* Soft skills: Strong administrative and organizational skills; effective communication and stakeholder coordination skills; ability to work in a matrix organization with diverse, global teams; problem\-solving mindset with ability to handle complex, ambiguous situations
* Technical skills: Basic MS Office skills, Kinaxis; understanding of pharmaceutical regulations (GDP, GMP) and quality management principles; experience with supply chain management systems and data analytics
* Education: Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Chemical Engineering / Process Engineering, Biotechnology / Life Sciences, Industrial Engineering / Production Engineering, Supply Chain / Operations Management
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

title: Procurement Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.
   

  

 In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.
   

  

 Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
* Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross\-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
* Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
* Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
* Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
* Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
* Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
* Manage cross\-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
* Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision\-making.
* Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
* Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional team environment.


**WE VALUE**
* Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
* Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
