description:
**Job title** 
 :
 **Project Manager CPMO tools \& AI enablement**
* Location: Ind\- Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Opella Digital is executing a multi\-year transformation program (Butterfly: 56 programs, 205\+ projects) supported by an integrated PMO \& OCM unit. The tooling landscape underpinning this transformation — Planisware, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, and the ELITEA, OpellaGPT AI platforms — has been designed and initially built by our implementation partner EPAM.
   

  

 We are now internalizing this capability. The PMO \& CMO Tools and Enablement Lead will act as the Product Owner and Project Manager of the full tooling ecosystem. You will not build the tools yourself — dedicated tech teams handle Planisware, Jira/Confluence, PowerBI, and OpellaGPT implementation. Your job is to gather requirements from all stakeholders across the Digital organization, translate them into actionable specifications, prioritize them, and project\-manage their implementation by the right tech teams.
   

  

 You are the bridge between business needs (what PMO, programme streams, OCM, and project teams need to see and do) and the technical teams that make it happen. You need a strong understanding of the underlying technology — not to code, but to know what’s possible, what’s feasible, and how systems connect. You think in data flows, integration patterns, and user requirements — then you drive delivery.
   

  

 A defining requirement of this role is to be an AI champion. Beyond running the tooling ecosystem, you are expected to actively drive the conversion of manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool ways of working toward AI\-assisted and automated workflows — using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected platforms — and to make AI and automation the default way the PMO and OCM operate. This expectation is weighted heavily in the recruitment process: candidates without a demonstrable AI\-automation track record are not a fit.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Requirements Gathering \& Product Ownership
* Act as the single Product Owner for the PMO \& CMO tooling ecosystem — own the backlog, prioritize features, and define what gets built and in what order
* Gather and consolidate requirements from multiple stakeholder layers: PMO dashboards, Butterfly stream dashboards, OCM/change management needs, project\-level dashboards, programme\-level reporting, DLT/SteerCo views
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and user stories that tech teams can implement
* Manage the requirements lifecycle: elicitation, documentation, validation, prioritization, change control
* Facilitate workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders across PMO, OCM, programme streams, and leadership to understand their reporting, tracking, and tooling needs
* Maintain a prioritized product backlog for the tooling ecosystem — balancing competing demands from PMO, OCM, and programme stakeholders
* Define acceptance criteria and validate delivered solutions against requirements before release
* AI Enablement \& Automation (Core Mandate)
* Champion AI and automation across the PMO and OCM — set the ambition, build momentum, demonstrate quick wins, and convert sceptics into adopters.
* Audit current ways of working and identify manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool processes that are candidates for automation.
* Drive the conversion of those processes to AI\-assisted and automated workflows using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected tooling — automated reporting and status roll\-ups, AI\-enabled change analytics, document and template generation.
* Embed AI into standard operating practice rather than leaving it as an optional add\-on; make automation the default, not the exception.
* Define and track AI\-adoption and conversion metrics (e.g. share of manual reports automated, hours saved, adoption rates) and report progress to the Head of PM Practice.
* Stay ahead of emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, ELITEA, PowerBI AI features) and translate them into practical improvements for the delivery and change teams.
* Project Management of Tooling Implementations
* Project\-manage the implementation of requirements across multiple tech teams: Planisware team, Jira/Confluence team, PowerBI team, OpellaGPT/ELITEA team, and any future platform teams
* Coordinate delivery across tech teams — manage dependencies, timelines, and integration points between platforms
* Track delivery progress, manage risks and issues, escalate blockers, and ensure on\-time delivery of tooling features
* Own the release management process — coordinate deployments across platforms, ensure regression testing, and manage rollout communication
* Manage the phased evolution of the reporting pipeline: from Phase 1 (manual) to Phase 2 (MCP/OpenAPI connectors) to Phase 3 (Planisware\-Jira synchronization)
* Coordinate with the Solution Architect on technical feasibility, platform evolution roadmap, and integration architecture
* Data Architecture Understanding \& Integration Design
* Understand where every datapoint lives across the ecosystem — Planisware (portfolio, schedules, budgets), Jira (project tracking, status), Confluence (governance), Snowflake (analytics), LMS (training completion), Veeva (content), knowledge platforms
* Design integration requirements: specify what data needs to flow between systems, in what direction, at what frequency, and in what format — then hand off to tech teams for implementation
* Understand the three\-layer reporting architecture: Data Layer → Orchestration Layer (ELITEA/OpellaGPT) → Presentation Layer (dashboards, PowerBI, Confluence) — and ensure requirements are correctly placed in the right layer
* Define data quality requirements and validation rules for the tooling ecosystem — ensure a consistent data baseline across the global portfolio
* Evaluate and recommend integration patterns (MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL) based on technical feasibility and business priority
* Ensure portability of data pipelines and workflows to future platforms (OpellaGPT) as those platforms mature
* CMO Tooling — Requirements \& Delivery
* Gather requirements from the OCM/Change team for the CMO tooling layer — understand what they need for change readiness tracking, adoption measurement, training management, and stakeholder engagement
* Understand enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms at a functional level — know what data they produce and how to specify integrations with the reporting ecosystem
* Translate CMO requirements into specifications for the relevant tech teams (PowerBI for dashboards, Confluence for templates, OpellaGPT for AI\-enabled change analytics)
* Project\-manage the build of CMO tools: change saturation heatmaps, adoption dashboards, training completion tracking, readiness assessments — as specified by the Central Change Manager
* Ensure CMO data feeds into the existing PMO dashboards — change readiness metrics, training completion, and adoption data visible alongside delivery data
* Unlock the benefits of AI solutions for OCM (OpellaGPT) — gather requirements for AI\-enabled change enablement, reporting, and analytics
* Stakeholder Management \& Training
* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders (PMO, OCM, programme streams, PMs) and the tech teams that implement tooling solutions
* Manage expectations across stakeholders — communicate priorities, timelines, trade\-offs, and delivery status
* Train project teams on how to use PMO and CMO tools — where to find them, how to use them, how to submit data at stage gates (the OCM team owns the content; this role owns the tooling how\-to)
* Develop self\-service training materials: guides, video walkthroughs, quick\-reference cards for both PMO and CMO tools
* Lead Communities of Practice sessions focused on tooling best practices and adoption
* Support new PM onboarding with tooling setup and orientation (coordinated with the Delivery Facilitation Lead)
* Continuous Improvement
* Continuously improve the tooling landscape based on user feedback, emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, PowerBI, ELITEA), and evolving programme needs
* Monitor tool adoption rates and flag under\-utilization to the Head of PM Practice
* Conduct periodic reviews of the tooling ecosystem with key stakeholders to identify gaps, redundancies, and improvement opportunities


**Technical Environment**
**This Role Requires Understanding Of The Following Platforms**
**Portfolio Management**
 Planisware (schedules, budgets, dependencies, milestones) — dedicated Planisware team implements
   

  

**Project Tracking**
 Jira Cloud Enterprise (epics, stories, status, RAG) — dedicated Jira/Confluence team implements
   

  

**Collaboration \& Docs**
 Confluence Cloud (governance pages, templates, documentation)
   

  

**Data Warehouse**
 Snowflake (analytical data, portfolio ingestion)
   

  

**AI / Orchestration**
 ELITEA Platform, OpellaGPT — dedicated AI team implements
   

  

**Reporting / BI**
 PowerBI, self\-contained HTML dashboards, Confluence publishing — dedicated BI team implements
   

  

**CMO / Change Platforms**
 LMS (Learning Management Systems), Veeva, knowledge platforms — data integration, not content creation
   

  

**Integration Patterns**
 MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL — understand and specify, tech teams implement
   

  

**About You**
* 6\+ years of experience in business analysis, project management, or product ownership in an enterprise IT/Digital environment
* Demonstrable track record of driving AI and automation adoption — converting manual, template\-based, or legacy\-tool processes into AI\-assisted or automated workflows, with evidence of results. This is an essential, defining requirement of the role.
* Proven ability to gather, translate, and prioritize requirements from multiple business stakeholders with competing needs
* Experience project\-managing implementations across multiple technical teams working on different platforms simultaneously
* Strong understanding of enterprise project/portfolio management tools (Planisware, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) — not as a developer, but as someone who understands their capabilities, data models, and integration possibilities
* Ability to think in data flows and system integration — understand where datapoints live, how systems connect, and what’s technically feasible without being the one who codes it
* Good understanding of enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms — at a functional level, not as a content creator
* Experience with reporting and BI tools (PowerBI, HTML dashboards, or similar) — understand what’s possible and specify requirements for BI teams
* Experience writing functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills — ability to facilitate workshops, manage expectations, and communicate trade\-offs across business and technical audiences
* Ability to train non\-technical users on enterprise tools — create training materials, deliver sessions, provide ongoing support
* Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams (India, Paris, Barcelona, global)
* Fluent English (written and spoken) — all documentation and training materials are in English


**Preferred**
* Experience working as Product Owner for an enterprise tooling or platform team
* Understanding of AI/ML platforms or agentic AI frameworks (OpellaGPT, LangChain, ELITEA, or equivalent) — at a functional level
* Experience specifying data integration requirements (MCP, OpenAPI, ETL, webhooks) for technical teams to implement
* Experience with Planisware\-Jira integration or cross\-platform synchronization projects
* Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or similar life sciences platforms


**Transition \& Onboarding**
 This role internalizes capability currently delivered by EPAM. The onboarding plan includes:
   

  

* Weeks 1\-4: Shadow period with EPAM team — understand the current tooling landscape, data flows, platform capabilities, and stakeholder requirements
* Weeks 3\-6: Begin gathering requirements independently; start building the product backlog; establish relationships with all tech teams
* Weeks 5\-8: Take over project management of ongoing tooling implementations; begin CMO tooling requirements gathering with Brent (OCM Lead)
* Month 3\+: Full autonomous ownership of the tooling backlog and delivery roadmap. EPAM engagement ends for tooling scope.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Butterfly program is one of the largest digital transformations in the FMCH industry — 56 programs, 205\+ projects. Every Program Manager, every SteerCo, and every leadership review depends on the dashboards and reporting this role delivers. On the change side, the tools you specify and drive to implementation will determine whether OCM is embedded in how projects are actually run, or stays as a theoretical framework.
   

  

 You will own the infrastructure that makes delivery visible and change trackable — with direct impact on global decision\-making.
   

  

 Why us?
   

  

 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
   

  

 You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co\-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in\-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Project Leadership: Spearhead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, expansions, and special projects.
   

  

 Financial Management: Direct multi\-million\-dollar security project lifecycles including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budgeting, change orders, and documentation.

 Quality Control: Support security system commissioning, testing, acceptance, and project handoff
   

  

 Knowledge Transfer: Develop and deploy comprehensive training programs for all physical security system users.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
   

  

 Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.

In most cases, our work starts even before customer purchases: in providing information about return policies on detail page/search \& during check\-out. and developing products to support end to end post purchase support needs.  Amazon Returns policies \& experience are foundational to Amazon’s e\-Commerce and one of the primary reasons why customers love shopping on Amazon. Returns policy communication on the detail page is among the top detail\-page features that increases Customer confidence and the Customer Trust Perception Index (CTPI) for purchase decision. This team has revolutionized the returns for customers through simplest possible experience with no need to print label \& do packaging and quickest refund time. Our team has been very successful in ensuring the lowest return rates and best in class return experience for Amazon as against other E\-commerce competitors.

Just as important, you will be the driving force behind an AI\-first mindset across every team and every solution, setting the expectation that AI\-assisted engineering is the default way of working, not an exception.

**AI\-First Leadership (Required)**

title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 As a Project Manager at Holmes AI, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving projects from initiation to completion. You will work closely with the leadership, technology, product, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the expected quality standards. The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, takes their work seriously, values the opportunity, and is comfortable working with flexibility in a fast\-paced startup environment. You should be highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of keeping multiple stakeholders aligned. A basic understanding of website development and technology projects is preferred. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding requirements, coordinating with technical teams, tracking progress, and identifying and escalating issues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and manage projects from planning and execution through completion.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate closely with the Tech/ Engineering team to ensure timely execution of development\-related projects.
* Manage website development projects at a superficial/project\-management level, including requirements, timelines, content, design, development, testing, and launch coordination.
* Translate business requirements into clear tasks and actionable deliverables for the relevant teams.
* Track project progress, identify delays or dependencies, and proactively drive resolution.
* Coordinate between leadership, technology, product, design, marketing, and other teams as required.
* Conduct regular project follow\-ups and ensure owners are accountable for their deliverables.
* Maintain project plans, trackers, documentation, meeting notes, and status updates.
* Identify project risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Coordinate testing and bug\-fixing activities with the Tech team before project releases.
* Track bugs and ensure they are assigned, prioritised, followed up on, and closed within agreed timelines.
* Ensure projects are delivered with the expected quality and attention to detail.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on project status, risks, timelines, and key decisions.
* Help establish and improve project management processes and ways of working as the company scales.
* Be flexible in handling changing priorities and take ownership of urgent or high\-priority requirements when needed. Required Skills \& Qualifications
* 3\+ years of experience in Project Management, Program Management, Operations, Product Operations, or a similar role.
* Strong project planning, coordination, execution, and follow\-up skills.
* Experience working with technology or software development teams.
* Basic understanding of website development and the overall software development lifecycle. ● Ability to understand requirements and convert them into clear tasks and timelines.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving blockers.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong working knowledge of project management and collaboration tools.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working in a B2B SaaS, AI, technology, or startup environment.
* Experience managing website development or software implementation projects.
* Basic understanding of APIs, frontend/backend development, QA/testing, and product releases.
* Experience coordinating with external vendors, developers, designers, or agencies.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and a bias toward action.



  





  





**What We Value** 




  





 At Holmes AI, we are looking for someone who sees this as more than just a job.
 



  





 We value someone who:
 



  




* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Takes the job seriously and is committed to delivering high\-quality work.
* Values the opportunity to work in an early\-stage, high\-growth company.
* Is dependable and follows through on commitments.
* Is comfortable working with flexibility when business priorities require it.
* Is proactive, resourceful, and willing to go beyond their defined responsibilities when required.
* Communicates openly and takes accountability for outcomes.
* Is comfortable working in an environment where things are being built, changed, and improved continuously.



  





  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
 


* Projects delivered on time and within agreed scope
* Project milestone and deadline adherence
* Timely coordination and follow\-up across teams
* Bug resolution and release readiness
* Project execution quality
* Stakeholder satisfaction and communication
* Timely identification and resolution of project blockers
* Documentation and project tracking accuracy
* Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and changing priorities
* Overall contribution to improving project execution and operational efficiency

An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**Brief Team/department Description**
 Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R\&D project management team, which coordinates cross\-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change\-inspired leader, to lead R\&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This role will report to the R\&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R\&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R\&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R\&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
   

  

 The role holder will lead cross\-functional initiatives to enhance R\&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology\-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R\&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement \& simplification opportunities.
   

  

 The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross\-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
   

  

**Principle Responsibilities**
* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO\-R\&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month\-on\-month project forecasts and manage CSO\-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R\&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R\&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co\-own the Long\-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R\&D opex, capex, and product\-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage\-wise Probability of Technical \& Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems \& processes:
* Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R\&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R\&D operational planning \- Lab space management, capex \& support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R\&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R\&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off\-the\-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in\-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting\-edge data tools and data\-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R\&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end\-to\-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in\-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R\&D / laboratory systems such as E\-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R\&D workflows
* Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on\-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R\&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R\&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems


**Qualifications/Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Master's degree preferred:
* MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
* MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
* Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
* PMP
* PgMP
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt


**Preferred Experience**
 15\-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:
   

  

**Project and Portfolio Management**
* At least 7\-10 years managing cross\-functional development programs.
* Experience with R\&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
* Experience leading governance meetings and stage\-gate reviews.


**Budget Management**
* Ownership or co\-ownership of departmental budgets.
* Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
* Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.


**Process and Organizational Change**
* Designing new departmental processes.
* Simplifying complex workflows.
* Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Creating governance models and decision\-making frameworks.
* Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

 The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership.  The individual in this role will own defined workstreams within the ECR program charter, collaborating with program, product, tech, BI, and Science partners to execute, validate, and deploy customer experience capabilities. This role will coordinate with teams across IN Ops to support the launch and adoption of bespoke product solutions within their assigned scope. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing moderate complexity and ambiguity. Successful candidates will have experience in Program Management, comfort working with cross\-organizational stakeholders, and the ability to manage competing priorities with appropriate escalation.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will own and deliver well\-defined workstreams and projects by coordinating with cross\-disciplinary teams to execute customer\-facing initiatives.  They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.
   

  

 They will implement and iterate on Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines — executing on use cases identified and scoped by leadership

title: Associate - Project Management - GS
description:
**Role Overview and Responsibilities:**
 Dhruva Space is seeking a driven and detail\-oriented Associate \- Project Management to oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of our satellite ground station infrastructure projects. In this high\-impact, hands\-on role, you will be the driving force behind our on\-the\-ground site deployments, managing everything from civil works to operational handover. You will balance strict project scheduling with on\-site coordination, managing vendors, controlling costs, and ensuring the seamless delivery of the ground infrastructure that supports our global satellite connectivity network.
 



**Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:** 
  




* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, critical path baselines, and execution milestones for site deployment.
   

 Supervise day\-to\-day progress across civil works (foundation pads, power backup, UPS, shelters), antenna structure assembly, and RF/hardware equipment setup.
* Monitor project expenditure, track cost baselines, manage procurement orders, and ensure strict adherence to allocated budgets.
* Coordinate with civil contractors, equipment suppliers, and EPC partners; track deliverables, enforce SLA compliance, and evaluate vendor performance.
* Manage supply chain logistics for heavy equipment transport and customs clearance, and track site\-level regulatory permits (e.g., WPC frequency approvals, local land/safety clearances).
* Maintain project risk registers, identify execution bottlenecks early, prepare weekly status reports, and present progress dashboards to engineering leads and management.



**Candidate Requirements:** 
  




* 1 to 3 years of demonstrated experience in project management, technical site execution, or engineering delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech / B.E.) in Electronics \& Communication, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Telecommunications Engineering.
* Prior experience in satellite ground station deployment is preferred
   

 Candidates with strong backgrounds in telecommunications infrastructure (cell tower roll\-outs), defence/radar systems, power/solar infrastructure, or industrial EPC projects are strongly encouraged to apply.
* Proficiency in standard project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or MS Excel).
* Strong vendor negotiation skills, budget management, and effective cross\-functional communication capabilities.

 Practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI evaluation and secure integration.

 Excellent people management, estimation, risk management, conflict resolution and executive communication.

description:

 The PI Quality Operations team will own the end\-to\-end quality operating rhythm across the PI BPO footprint within the GSO network, including quality audits, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), calibrations, quality score governance, insight generation, and quality improvement interventions . The team's mandate is to ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, trusted, and actionable , while identifying the key drivers of performance and translating quality data into clear actions that improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
   

  

 The Quality Operations Manager \- Platform Integrity (PI) will lead this team of approximately 5\-7 Quality S\-ladder team members and be accountable for the overall health and performance of PI Quality Operations. The manager will partner closely with BPO Operations, Vendor Management, Training, Program, Policy, Product, Analytics, and Global Quality stakeholders to strengthen quality governance, address systemic performance gaps, and ensure quality insights lead to measurable improvements in frontline execution.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own PI Quality performance across the BPO network , driving sustained improvement in Quality scores and building clear recovery plans for underperforming sites, queues, or agent populations.
* Ensure Quality scores are accurate, consistent, and trusted by owning audit governance, sampling effectiveness, evaluator accuracy, score integrity, and scoring consistency across the network.
* Lead audit, Audit\-the\-Auditor (ATA), and calibration programs to improve evaluator accuracy, reduce scoring variance, and strengthen alignment across internal and BPO Quality teams.
* Turn Quality data into actionable insights by identifying key defect drivers, conducting root\-cause analysis, and translating findings into targeted actions that improve agent performance.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Operations, Training, Policy, Program, Product, and Analytics to address systemic Quality issues and improve processes, tooling, scorecards, and frontline execution.
* Drive continuous improvement and scalability by simplifying, standardizing, and improving Quality operating mechanisms across sites, markets, languages, and lines of business.

* Experience managing Quality professionals and demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and performance\-manage a team.
* Demonstrated experience improving Quality scores through structured root\-cause analysis and operational interventions rather than solely monitoring or reporting performance.
* Strong understanding of Quality measurement integrity , including scoring consistency, inter\-rater reliability, evaluator variance, sampling methodology, and calibration.
* Proven ability to analyze Quality data, identify performance drivers, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into improvement plans.
* Strong understanding of BPO operating environments, including vendor governance, performance management, SLAs/KPIs, corrective action planning, and multi\-site operations.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience using statistical or analytical techniques to evaluate scoring reliability, performance variation, and Quality trends..
* Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or other Quality/process\-improvement certification is advantageous.
* Multilingual experience or experience supporting multilingual Quality operations is a plus.


****What Success Looks Like****
**Success In This Role Means**
* PI Quality scores show sustained and measurable improvement.
* Quality scores are trusted by Operations and BPO partners as an accurate representation of frontline performance.
* Audit and ATA accuracy remain consistently high across the network.
* Evaluator variance decreases, and calibration alignment improves.
* Quality insights consistently identify the highest\-impact performance opportunities and lead to concrete operational action.
* Quality interventions demonstrate measurable improvement in agent behavior and performance.

 Supply Chain
   

  

 Quality
   

  

 Front Line Supervision
   

  

 Carrier Excellence
   

  

 TOW/Project Management
   

  

 Other: Analytics, Automation \& AI / Digital Transformation
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution (Engineering / Supply Chain / Analytics preferred).
* 12\+ years’ experience in supply chain / operations, with strong exposure to process excellence, PMO/governance, and performance management.
* Proven track record in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement (Lean/Kaizen), with measurable business impact.

title: Sr. Program Manager, ECR, NOC ECR
description:
**Description**
 The Executive Customer Relations Team operates within Amazon India's Network Operations Center (NOC), serving as the critical bridge between senior leadership escalations and systemic customer experience improvement. The team manages direct escalations from L10\+ leaders requiring comprehensive investigation, root cause analysis, executive\-level communications, and cross\-functional action item ownership. This team aims to transform every executive escalation into a systemic improvement opportunity by conducting rigorous root cause analysis, driving timely CAPA closures, and identifying thematic defect patterns that convert to programmatic interventions — ultimately reducing repeat defects and elevating the end\-to\-end customer experience across Amazon India's operations.
   

  

 The individual in this role will collaborate across a team of program, product, tech, BI and Science leaders to plan, execute, validate, and deploy complex customer experience capabilities. This role will partner will partner with teams across IN Ops to launch and drive impact through bespoke product solutions. The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a proven track record of delivering results while managing high level of complexity. Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management, have experience working with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities.
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will identify, scope, and deliver large end\-to\-end programs by engaging cross\-disciplinary teams to design innovative customer\-facing initiatives. You thrive by creating a vision, building consensus, and driving results — anticipating bottlenecks, managing escalations, making trade\-offs, and balancing business needs against technical constraints. You must break down complex projects into manageable deliverables with clear functional specifications and execute them on time. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to influence are essential. Self\-sufficiency in data analysis and working knowledge of SQL are critical. The role will also champion Generative AI adoption within ECR — including automated case summarization, pattern recognition for thematic defects, and predictive escalation routing — identifying opportunities where Gen AI can augment human judgment, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution timelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* They will be responsible for working with all Miles (LM, MM, FC), Multiple Program teams (ACES, DSP, IHS, FC), and Multiple Product teams (ROW APEX, DEX, RCX) to identify pain points and scope out large high\-impact solutions to improve Delivery Experience.
* They will be responsible for driving VP inquiries to closure within SLA with clear articulation of issue and recommended initiatives to arrest the root cause of the defect. They will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure Action Item progress and own writing reports that detail progress to leadership on a frequent basis.
* They will liaise across functions to drive their projects, help clear issues and bottlenecks, and work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed.
* They will identify, pilot, and scale Generative AI solutions (e.g., automated case summarization bots, AI\-assisted root cause analysis, intelligent response suggestion engines) to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate VP inquiry resolution timelines.
* They will help define the Gen AI product roadmap for ECR in partnership with Science and Tech teams — establishing success metrics, conducting A/B testing of AI\-assisted workflows, and ensuring responsible AI deployment with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop guardrails.
